description: The Analyst's meaning-making workflow: document(s) in, a multi-step method, text + tables + figures out. Ten recorded steps; step 4 is an executor sub-plan of 1-4 engine phases (numbered 4.1, 4.2, …) whose prose feeds the later steps; steps 5-9 are the concretization passes (spine → exhibits from the spine → draft with the exhibits in hand → cross-check).

phases.phase_description: Read every document (1M-context path when large): a DocumentProfile per document (genre, thesis, key claims with verbatim anchors, entities, tensions) and a corpus map (shared questions, disagreements).
Exactly three angles (tellings) with executable engines, cost/time estimates and output shape; status becomes awaiting_brief unless autopilot.

A WorkflowExecutionPlan restricted to executable engines (capability YAML present). Depth policy: simple = 1 engine × 1 pass, medium = 2-3 engines chained, advanced = 3-4 engines + synthesis. Records strategy_rationale and alternatives_considered.
Runs the plan through the executor as sub-phases 4.1, 4.2, … (one engine each, every phase receiving the prior phases' prose as context). Sub-job events are mirrored into the dossier's event stream.

Composition read (plain summary, buried crux, readers, strands, what should be a table / a diagram / prose), then the spine: a thesis, 3-7 sections with ONE claim each, per-section table and figure specs commissioned by the claim, planned verbatim anchors, and distinct jobs for the summary and the conclusion. Walls: one claim per section, exhibits within budget, no digits in captions, anchors verbatim; field-patch retry.

phases.name: Draw the plates
phases.description: Whole-page 4K diagrams (scorecard, framework map, flow map, register…) that can be read instead of the memo; planned from the spine, rendered, checked label by label.

phases.phase_description: Exactly the tables the spine commissioned, keyed by section_key with what each row set proves; the anchor wall drops rows whose quotes are not in the source text; a table that falls short is a recorded finding (per-exhibit skip law).

Exactly the diagrams the spine commissioned (primitive + format + picture_shows / caption_says), filled with labels from the analysis, rendered through the images contract and checked against their own spec; a failed check is a recorded finding.

Sections written in the spine's order with the finished exhibits on the desk, placing each table and diagram at the pointer with [[table:key]] / [[figure:key]] tokens; summary and conclusion written LAST against the assembled body to their declared jobs. Walls: section order, every exhibit placed exactly once, no new numbers, anchors verbatim; section-scoped patch retries. Then Jinja2 HTML → PDF → Markdown.

The first judgment against the real things: does each diagram depict its section's claim, do the rows match the claims, is anything asserted without backing, do captions restate prose, do summary and conclusion duplicate. Findings ledger with one affordance each; code clamps (fragment anchors, caption digits, unpointed exhibits, failed picture checks) outrank the judge. simple: report only; medium+: one round of safe automatic realizations, re-rendering only what changed.
Every LLM/image call receipted (model, tokens, cost, duration, prompt/result hashes); totals on the job.

output_description: dossier.html, dossier.pdf, dossier.md under DOSSIER_DIR/<job_id>/, plus tables, figures, receipts and the full event ledger.
